caption: The drawing depicts a decorative oil lamp composed of several distinct parts. At the top is a clear, textured glass lampshade with circular ribbed patterns and a slightly domed shape. Below the shade, the upper part of the lamp consists of a brass or gold-colored metal fixture. The lamp's main body features a cylindrical section with a pink background, decorated with an illustration of a crane (or similar large bird) standing among green reeds and red-tipped foliage. The base of the lamp is made of a dark material shaped into a multi-tiered pedestal, providing stability. On the lower right side of the image, there is handwritten text reading "Willoughby 1015." The background of the drawing is plain, with a light cream color and some visible flecks and minor stains.
title: Lamp Base
